dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Goh speaking. Thank you for calling. How may I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Calling to settle what we discussed previously. Finally got a quiet moment in the office, so better call before everyone starts looking for me again. My FIN is G nine three nine five five eight five Y. My date of birth is the first of June nineteen fifty-four.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. I have your file open. Are you comfortable speaking where you are, or would you prefer to move somewhere more private?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'm in my own room, door closed. Can talk here. My work schedule changed quite a bit recently; now the staff discussions are spread throughout the day instead of all being together.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That can make it harder to find an uninterrupted window. For future contact, would you prefer us to arrange calls in advance rather than try to reach you between meetings?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Arrange first, better lah. Sometimes the diary looks empty, then suddenly got supplier coming over. If you send a message asking when I'm free, I can check properly rather than answer while walking around.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that contact preference. We can use the usual secure messaging channel to arrange a suitable time. There is no need to organise a branch visit just to discuss routine administrative matters.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Telephone much easier for me. Going down to the branch means leaving the office, finding parking, then rushing back. On the phone I can have my papers in front of me and get straight to the point.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can keep today's discussion focused. You have your papers with you, so please take me through what you wanted to settle.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I was considering Nova Technology Equity Fund. Also had Summit Global Equity ETF in mind as an alternative. I wrote the names down after our previous discussion. The notes are a bit untidy, but I've got the right page here now.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: There is no rush while you check your notes. Your objective remains long-term capital growth through technology businesses, with this investment kept separate from money needed for everyday spending.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll go with the earlier-mentioned fund lah, the one I mentioned first.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend Nova Technology Equity Fund because its technology focus matches your long-term growth objective and interest in technology businesses, while its portfolio spreads exposure across companies. Nova Technology Equity Fund concentrates on technology businesses, so its value can fall sharply when technology shares weaken together. Do you understand how that technology-sector concentration could cause the fund's value to fall sharply?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. Technology shares fall together, this fund can drop sharply too.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive returns in the future.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I want to buy, not sell. For this transaction, use Japanese yen. The amount I'm putting into this is 1,000,000. Quantity, put 500 units. Use a market order for this, please.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Let me read that back: 2,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: No, the quantity should be 500 units. The rest stays the same.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for pointing that out. With the quantity corrected, please confirm your final instruction: buy 500 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund for an amount of 1,000,000 in Japanese yen, using a market order.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected quantity. Go ahead, please.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. Any related correspondence will be sent through the usual secure channel. If an administrative follow-up is needed, we can arrange a call rather than interrupt your meetings.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That works for the calls. Just leave me a message if I'm tied up; no need to keep trying while I'm with the staff. I'll check it when I'm back at my desk.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I will note that. Thank you for calling, and I hope the rest of your working day goes smoothly.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. Better get back to it now. Bye.
